_comment: R31 PROPOSAL — the tuple-shaped replacement for harness/verify/suite_baseline.json. Written here, at a receipts path, because harness/verify/suite_baseline.json is deny-listed from agent edit in BOTH profiles (harness/agent-settings.json:34, harness/relay-settings.json:61). Promotion is a human act. Read by harness/verify/checks.py::parse_tuple_baseline; the flat single-interpreter shape is now a hard error, never a silent fallback.
_shipping_honesty: The shipping numbers are BAD and are recorded as measured. Form (a) RAW `hython -m pytest tests/` does not merely score lower — it CANNOT COLLECT: 3 collection errors abort the session with 'Interrupted: 3 errors during collection', 0 tests run. The counts below are form (a) forced through with --continue-on-collection-errors, which is the honest full-population number (it keeps the 3 collection errors in the total). They are NOT the runner form (b): harness/run_suite_shipping_python.ps1:23 --ignores exactly those 3 files, which deletes the finding from the report rather than recording it.

gate.interpreter: python 3.14.2 (C:/Python314/python.exe) — vendor tree INACTIVE (_VENDOR_ABI_RISK=True), tests pip-installed deps

shipping.collection_status: BROKEN — 3 collection errors (tests/test_load.py, tests/test_passthrough_hygiene.py, tests/test_port_wave_scene1.py: ModuleNotFoundError: websockets). Without --continue-on-collection-errors the session is Interrupted and 0 tests run.
shipping.raw_unforced_result: collected 4950 items / 3 errors / 1 skipped, then Interrupted — 0 passed

_ratchet_note: checks.py::check_suite_baseline ratchets the GATE leg only (it re-runs pytest under sys.executable each sprint). The SHIPPING leg is shape-enforced and reported as RECORDED-NOT-RERUN so a stale number cannot read as a fresh green. Whether the shipping leg should also be ratcheted per sprint is a cost decision escalated to the human, not decided by the agent.
